# Fixture

`sample.jsonl` is a format sample for the parser, not a byte copy of the official pages. The table structure and
indicator labels follow monitoring.miccedu.ru institution pages; the values of institution 1 (editions 2025 and 2019)
are the ones read from the official pages on 2026-11-11. Values that were not read are left empty. `sha256` is the
hash of the fixture tables, not of the original page.
